verbum.title: Verbum
verbum.description: Guess the word of the day in 6 tries. A new word every day at 00:00.

help.title: How to play
help.intro: Guess the word in 6 tries. Each guess must be a valid Spanish word with the number of letters shown.
help.correct: The letter is in the word and in the right spot.
help.present: The letter is in the word but in another spot.
help.absent: The letter is not in the word.
help.accents: Accents don't count and Ñ is a letter of its own.
help.daily: There is a new word every day at 00:00 (Argentina time). Use the calendar to play past days.
help.time: The clock starts when you open the puzzle and stops with your last guess. If you leave and come back later, it keeps counting.
help.editing: Tap any tile to type there. On a keyboard: ← and → move, Backspace clears and steps back, and _ clears the tile and moves on.

errors.notAvailable: Pick another day on the calendar.
errors.submit: We couldn't send your guess. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Log in again to keep playing; your guesses are saved.

result.newAvailable: The new Verbum is ready! Play →
result.archiveNote: Played from the calendar: it doesn't count for the streak.
